label: Formaggio di malga dell'Altopiano dei Sette Comuni

about.text: A raw cow's-milk alpine cheese of the Sette Comuni plateau near Asiago in Veneto, made from partly skimmed milk from two milkings. Its aged version, stravecchio, is aged 19 months or more and is a Slow Food presidium.

sources.text: What it is and how it is made, from this.
